description: aphrody plugin hooks. SessionStart: injects a session-level reminder steering Claude towards the native MCP docs tools. NOTE (2026-05-21): the previous `cargo xtask install-mcp` auto-build/redeploy hooks were removed with the aphrody-xtask crate. Rebuild aphrody-mcp manually after touching crates/google_mcp/src/*.rs: `cargo build --release -p aphrody-mcp` then copy target/release/aphrody-mcp to ~/.local/bin/.

hooks.command: echo 'aphrody-mcp ready: 18 native tools available. For ANY library / framework / SDK / API / cloud-service question, call `mcp__aphrody__docs_auto_search` FIRST (fans out Context7 + Microsoft Learn + Google in parallel). Drill down with microsoft_docs_fetch / context7_query_docs / universal_web_fetch on a specific URL.'
